detailed_description:
The target video is live-action and cinematic, a cold blue-green arctic dusk with the aurora glowing overhead, snow-covered rocks and dark cliffs, an old wooden sailing ship moored behind.
[Shot 1] A vertical full-length static shot frames <Subject 1> standing centred on the snowy shore from head to knees, breathing softly, hair stirring in the cold wind, her expression calm and a little wary. She glances down as a bright orange glow kindles at the centre of her chest. In an instant the glow erupts into flame that races outward over her whole body, up through her ginger hair and down her legs, until she is fully engulfed and standing as a tall figure of roaring fire, her shape and features still readable inside the flames. Embers and sparks swirl upward into the aurora, the snow at her feet hisses into steam, and the flames light the snow, the rocks and the side of the ship in flickering orange.

overall_soundscape: Cold wind over the shore, a sharp whoomph of ignition, then a continuous roar and crackle of fire with sizzling steam from the snow.

non_diegetic_music: A deep low brass swell that rises with the ignition and holds.
